content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect polarity settings of the reset GPIOs for the WiFi power sequence in the Device Tree Source (DTS) files for the Raspberry Pi 3 B and 3 B+. Specifically, the reset GPIOs were mistakenly configured to be active high instead of active low. This misconfiguration prevented the WiFi functionality from operating correctly, particularly since the power sequence only takes effect when the relevant MMC driver is compiled as a module, which likely masked the issue during testing.
